title: swetest bug
description: this command: swetest -house86.0134,39.9573,w -b10.07.2026 -ut18:00 -sid1 -emos doesnt align with c's swetest. the house cusp speeds vary, but c-swetest indicates they are all the same, as they should be for whole sign houses. hopefully this is just a bug in swetest, not in swisseph-rs itself. check it out
root_cause: HouseSystem::try_from(u8) only matched uppercase ASCII letters. C's swehouse.c uses toupper(hsys) at the entry point so lowercase works, but the Rust TryFrom returned Err for lowercase input. swetest's unwrap_or(Placidus) silently swallowed the error, causing all lowercase house system letters to compute Placidus cusps regardless of the requested system.
